items.a: Primarily **a metabolic condition of the brain**, and **significantly preventable**.

items.q: How do genes and lifestyle interact?
items.a: **Genetics loads the gun; lifestyle pulls the trigger.**

items.q: When should you start watching brain-risk markers?
items.a: In your **30s and 40s**: blood sugar, blood pressure, body fat and lipids.

items.q: What is the most powerful brain tool?
items.a: **Movement**, both **aerobic and resistance**; build muscle early.

items.q: Where does hidden sugar show up?
items.a: Sauces and glazes at **40–50% sugar** and **fat-free** dressings.
**Polyphenol-rich** foods: berries, coloured vegetables, **extra-virgin olive oil**, coffee.

items.q: Which non-food factor makes his top five?
What did the Cochrane review find on amyloid drugs?
items.a: **No meaningful slowing** across 17 studies and 20,342 patients.

items.q: What did a 20-week lifestyle trial show?
items.a: About **70% of patients stabilised or improved**.
